reviews.t: Received the cheaper, flatter, version with no adjustable straps!
reviews.x: For this outlandish price, I was expecting two of the nicer fat padded Shut Eye adjustable masks with darkening flaps and received two of the cheaper versions. "Sleep Mask" is on this label, they are really cheap and  flat. I have purchased other brands, similar, for under $4 for myself. I don't usually write negative reviews but this was outright a cheapo bait and switch. I needed a mask to replace the original Shut Eye adjustable mask my son requires for a good night's sleep. Why should I have

I have a room where the sun comes in every morning, and it makes it difficult for me to sleep in a little on the weekends if I want.  Pros - The mask does a great job of blocking out most light.  My head is right next to a window in my bedroom and I can hardly tell when it's morning. The silk is a nice as well. Getting two of them works for me as well.  Cons - The adjustable strap is only slightly adjustable meaning there isn't much wiggle room between the two pieces of velcro to make adjustment

reviews.t: Side by side comparison of three sleep masks-Earth Theraputics is no longer my favorite
reviews.x: This is a side-by-side comparison of three masks: [[ASIN:B001ET7HJI Earth Therapeutics Mind/Body Therapy Sleep Mask, Cotton, Silk]] [[ASIN:B00FJQFJX8 Bedtime Bliss® Contoured & Comfortable Sleep Mask & Moldex® Ear Plugs]] [[ASIN:B00M9BC1M8 Premium Quality Eye Mask with Contoured Shape By Nidra]]  I've used the Earth Therapeutics soft mask for five years, and the the Nidra and Bedtime Bliss masks for the last several months. All have their advantages and disadvantages. My favorite is now the Nidr

I hate this eye mask for several reasons. First, I don't like satin on my face. I didn't know this until I bought this eye mask. It sticks to my face cream and doesn't let the skin breathe. Second, it pushes down on your eyes because there are no cupped pockets for you to open your eyes. Third, the Velcro from the back of the strap sticks to my pillow and is ruining my pillow case. I recommend getting one that is cotton and allows you to open your eyes.

I buy a lot of these masks, I used to get them from Bed Bath and Beyond but they stopped selling them (or I couldnt find them) so I started buying them on Amazon. ITS THE BEST MASK! Adjustable Velcro strap, it has tiny pockets in the under-eye area that I dont use that often but if im going traveling I will put an earplug in each one so I know I brought a pair with me. The mask is thick enough that NO light shines through if my eyes are open while im wearing it which is amazing since the slighte

This product did not work as well as the cheaper ones I had gotten during airline flights.  It is thick, which makes it somewhat warm over your face.  I don't know if I could use it in the summer.  Secondly, it really doesn't block out the light too well, the light comes in from the bottom area.

I love this mask. I love it so much that I have been buying it for over 10 years. But this purchase I am unsure about. Part of me wonders if they are "fakes" even though the packaging looks legit. They came with a heavy chemical smell on them when I pulled them out of the plastic and while I do have a very sensitive sense of smell I have never had that issue with this mask before. I have been airing them out in the weeks since I received them as there is no way I can handle that smell on

The mask is absolutely heavenly on the eyes and face, however, it will move during the night and the elastic is horribly cheap, it loses its shape and twists and no amount of ironing can set it straight again, when the elastic gives way the velcro becomes a nightmare.

I've been using these for years. I'll keep buying replacements as long as they make them! They're washable (I'd recommend on gentle/cold and in a lingerie bag) and mine usually last a couple of years with weekly washings. The elastic isnt' as sturdy as the mask itself, nor does it hold as snugly as I like, so I DIY and add some 1.5 or 2 inch elastic and hand sew it in place of what comes on the mask. However, the mask is the really good part that makes these a really good value and repeat buy fo

the strap is too short, thankfully the Velcro holds but over time as you wash it the straps get stretched out and you have to cut them and tie a knot to keep them on. the seaming on the front separates from the black trim and exposes the batting inside which is messy and can lead one to BREATHE the fibers while sleeping. This is my 6th pair in 6 yrs. and this time it seems over padded and the straps are definitely shorter. WHY?
They've got these awful flaps on the inside (the side that goes on your FACE) that push against your eyeballs. This has the exact opposite intended effect. They kept us up, so we threw them away.

As soon as I got the masks, I used one that night. It was SUPER soft, and the mask is also adjustable. reviews.x: I won't say the product is necessarily bad, but I certainly do not like it and am not pleased with the disparity between the description and the actual product.  While the amazon page says these eye-covers are made of cotton and silk, the product packaging and tags both indicate the product is cotton, silk, AND polyester. I would not have bought these had I known this as my wife reacts to polyester. This just leaves me with another useless set of eye covers that my wife can't use.  Also, I perso

reviews.t: I got this for my husband, because he has a problem with getting to sleep.
reviews.x: He especially has trouble getting back to sleep if he wakes up in the night. I heard that lavender oil can help with sleep, so I mainly got the mask as something to spritz lavender scent on. He finds the mask very comfortable and likes the scent of lavender very much, and says he finds it easier to get to sleep and stay asleep when using them. (Personally, I detest the scent of lavender, but it doesn't drift to my side of the bed and stay there, so we're fine!)

reviews.t: My favorite for plane travel and sleeping in
reviews.x: I travel for business frequently and so I have tried a lot of sleep masks. This beats them all, even the $25 super-contoured fancy variety. Most synthetic sleep masks feel uncomfortable against my skin, some even sweaty. They also tend not to block the light out very well. The silk fabric of this mask is cool and soft, with nice padding and a good shape to block out all the light. reviews.x: I got an affordable 2-pack of these plus another sleep mask to try. (I'd never used sleep masks before.)  This one is good: very soft and light.  It is pretty good about blocking light.  However, my other mask has contours so as not to touch your eyes: it is wonderful.  This one: just pretty good.  I can tell the difference for "sensory deprivation" that helps me forget about where I'm at and fall asleep easier and return to sleep faster at night when I wake up. This one is nice, but it is only

reviews.t: Let’s light in | Stiff uncomfortable straps
reviews.x: I bought a Therapeutics eye mask years ago and loved it. The original had a silk mini pillow case around another silk pillow filled with small seeds. This extra little weight allowed the mask to sit on your eyes comfortably and with out that pesky strap around your head that seems to both strangle you while sticking to your hair. Unfortunately this wasn’t the same one.  This eye mask is light weight. So light in fact that it lets light through the material. The straps are stiff and uncomfortable

My bedroom faces the east and has an uncovered half-moon window above the one with blinds.  In the summer the light begins to pour in before 5 AM and, being a light sleeper, I would wake up and have a difficult time getting back to sleep afterwards, which eventually, led me to search for a sleep mask.  I purchased these masks and another, molded one that came with earplugs.  This is my very favorite and I shared the second of the set with my night-shift working daughter, as I felt it might help

I first bought these sleep masks at BB&B (for lots more money). I have tried at least half a dozen kinds--foam, silk, etc. These have little flaps of soft material on the inside, which gives your eyes a little more room. The wide strap fastens with Velcro, so it is infinitely adjustable, as well as comfortable. They stay put and block out light. The fragrance is nice-- not overwhelming. I'm so glad I found these on Amazon. You get two for this price--a good deal. Update: These are still good and

these are the best fitting .and very comfy. has added pouches on the inside that block light from coming in around the nose but i had to give then only 3 stars because the elastic band goes bad around 2 to 3 months. looses its stretch. i bought some elastic 1/2" and cut the old band and stapled the new one in its place,

I work graves and this eyemask works perfectly for blocking out light.  It's very light, breathable, comfortable, and the strap stays on well.  There is no odor like one other posted and it doesn't have pink fur around the edge so you can actually use it as a man lol just kidding, but it is nice.
The thin head band hurts the tops of my ears, I wake up sore as hell.  Also this is a mask that puts significant pressure on the eyes.  Some people like that, but it drives me nuts.

reviews.t: I bought this years ago at bed bath and beyond ...
reviews.x: I bought this years ago at bed bath and beyond, it kept for years. When I ordered this one, the stitching was not as in tact and the strap broke after the second time using it.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the mask soft, comfortable, and effective at blocking out light.
Several reviewers report the elastic strap is cheap, too short, or loses its shape over time.
Some reviewers complain of a strong chemical smell upon opening the product.
A few reviewers report receiving a cheaper or possibly counterfeit version than expected, with material discrepancies.
Some reviewers find the mask uncomfortable, citing pressure on the eyes or poor fit.

qa.q: Is it comfortable enough to sleep in all night?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on all-night comfort: one husband found it comfortable and easier to stay asleep [2], and another reviewer found the silk cool and soft [4], but one reviewer called it uncomfortable sleep, citing satin sticking to face cream and pressure on the eyes [1].

claims.text: One reviewer's husband found the mask very comfortable and said he found it easier to get to sleep and stay asleep when using it.
One reviewer found the silk fabric cool and soft and said it feels great against the skin.
One reviewer described uncomfortable sleep, disliking satin on the face because it sticks to face cream and doesn't let skin breathe, and noting it pushes down on the eyes.

qa.q: Does it block out light completely?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it blocks out light completely or nearly so [1][3][4][6], while others report light leaking in from the bottom and not blocking well [2][5].

claims.text: Some reviewers say it blocks out light completely or nearly so.
Other reviewers say it does not block light well, with light coming in from the bottom.

qa.q: Will it fit my head size?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on fit: one reviewer with a "pretty big head" found the straps long enough to tighten fully [1], while another describes the strap as adjustable Velcro [4][5], but a third calls the elastic cheap and prone to losing shape [6]. No review gives a specific head size, so exact fit cannot be confirmed.

claims.text: A reviewer with a pretty big head had to use the end of the velcro on each strap to make it tight enough, indicating the straps are long.
The wide strap fastens with Velcro and is infinitely adjustable.
The mask has an adjustable Velcro strap.
The elastic is cheap, loses its shape, and twists.

qa.q: Does the material feel soft against the skin?
qa.answer: Most reviewers describe the material as soft against the skin, with several calling it "super soft" or "very soft and light" [1][2][3][4][6]. However, one reviewer disliked the satin on their face, saying it sticks to face cream and doesn't let skin breathe [5].

claims.text: The silk fabric is described as cool and soft and feels great against the skin [1].
One reviewer called the mask SUPER soft [2].
Another described it as very soft and light [3].
It was described as lightweight, soft and fairly breathable [4].
One reviewer said it is very silky and soft [6].
One reviewer disliked the satin on their face, saying it sticks to face cream and doesn't let the skin breathe [5].

qa.q: Is it durable and machine washable?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on durability: one says the strap broke after the second use [1], while another says masks last a couple of years with weekly washings [2]. On washing, one reviewer says they are washable and recommends gentle/cold in a lingerie bag [2], but another notes straps stretch out over time as you wash it [5].

claims.text: The strap broke after the second time using it.
Masks usually last a couple of years with weekly washings.
They are washable, recommended on gentle/cold in a lingerie bag.
Over time as you wash it the straps get stretched out.
